Kevin Trudeau's claim: almost everyone he's seen with depression tests low in one mineral - lithium, not the drug, the trace mineral.

His story: when 7-Up launched as 'The Uncola,' it skipped the cocaine Coca-Cola started with and the caffeine from kola nut - and ran on raw cane sugar, carbonation and a small dose of mineral lithium instead, for the same lift.

His point: the pharmaceutical version is a patented, man-made form of the same mineral your body may already be short on, which he says is why drug companies built a drug around it in the first place.

When's the last time you had your mineral levels checked?

#kevintrudeau #naturalhealth #mineraldeficiency #wbdaily #readthelabel #healthtruth

Kevin Trudeau's low-cost pick for stress and low mood: a mini trampoline.

His reasoning: jumping on a rebounder, a method he credits to his friend Al Carter, stimulates the lymphatic system and squeezes every cell in the body, which he says helps move toxins out.

His backup list if you skip the trampoline: yoga, running, calisthenics, Pilates, martial-arts style stretching, or straightforward strength training - any of it, he says, helps.

What's your go-to way to move when you're stressed?
